subject: general
question:
Study the given information carefully and answer the question that follows.

Five friends Komal, Harris, Paul, Daniel and Meghana are standing in a row facing north but not necessarily in the same order. Only Harris is between Komal and Meghana. Paul is to the immediate right of Meghana. Daniel is to the immediate left of Komal.

Which of the following statements is true?

options.text: Daniel is third to the left of Meghana.
Harris is to the right of Meghana.
Harris is to the left of Komal.
Komal is third to the left of Harris.

solution:
Given:

Five friends Komal, Harris, Paul, Daniel and Meghana are standing in a row facing north.

1) Only Harris is between Komal and Meghana.

2) Paul is to the immediate right of Meghana.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a672598d38b9edee5394f29a749dad83a99fc4d5a44be0a3260c1e0040a35772.png] 

3) Daniel is to the immediate left of Komal.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/84996f05cfc376489ed974f3c5d36a22a95738c0052bdce6cb1d7a3e309247dc.png] 

Now check all the Options,

Option (1): Daniel is third to the left of Meghana → True (Daniel is third to the left of Meghana)

Option (2): Harris is to the right of Meghana → False (Paul is to the right of Meghana)

Option (3): Harris is to the left of Komal → False (Daniel is to the left of Komal)

Option (4): Komal is third to the left of Harris → False (Noting is sitting third to the left of Harris)

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (1)".
